c1.hasil_ringkas: Pencacahan tandan pisang dengan YOLO-Banana dan DeepSORT pada video RGB-D mencapai rerata akurasi 96,82% per baris (6 baris, 61 tandan); estimasi bobot total 1.195,69 kg terhadap 1.163,69 kg aktual (akurasi 97,25%, RMSE 12,81 kg).

bukti: the DeepSORT was used to solve the repeated counting based on the Hungarian algorithm and Kalman filtering
calculated the Mahalanobis distance and cosine distance with the predicted result tracks, obtained the motion features and appearance features
the statistics steadily neared the actual value, and the average accuracy of each row gradually increased to 96.82%
catatan: DeepSORT dikodekan M2+M3 sesuai konvensi. Tiga batasan tambahan (lama pelacakan, jarak depth 1,5-2,5 m, rentang bobot) adalah penyaring pencacahan, bukan asosiasi dalam kerangka koordinat bersama, sehingga M4 tidak diberikan. Sumber angka aktual jumlah tandan tidak dijelaskan rinci; ditafsirkan sebagai hitungan di kebun, dan bobot aktual sebagai hasil panen. Tidak ada metrik identitas (MOTA/IDF1).

yang_dicoba: Semantic Scholar API (abstrak disembunyikan penerbit, hanya tldr); OpenAlex (tanpa abstrak); WebSearch gagal karena kuota sesi habis; curl ke https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-02958-0_18 (halaman Springer) memberi abstrak verbatim.
bukti: the main goal of this study is to improve the seed region growing algorithm in order to gain higher accuracy in segmenting color information for oil palm fruit image
The data sample consists of 80 images which comprises and two ripeness classes (ripe and unripe)
The proposed work has out-performed the k-mean clustering method with 86% and 80% of average accuracy rates correspondingly
catatan: Kutipan verbatim dari abstrak di halaman Springer. Abstrak tidak menyebut lokasi pengambilan citra (pohon, tanah, atau pabrik); kontribusi utamanya segmentasi warna dengan n-Seed Region Growing untuk dua kelas kematangan.

yang_dicoba: Semantic Scholar API (abstrak disembunyikan penerbit); OpenAlex (tanpa abstrak); WebSearch gagal karena kuota sesi habis; curl ke https://doi.org/10.1007/s11119-024-10132-1 (halaman Springer) memberi abstrak verbatim.

c1.hasil_ringkas: YOLOv5s-little (mAP 99,5%) dengan DeepSORT yang diperbaiki mencapai HOTA 79,6%, MOTA 92,58%, IDF1 95,02%, dan IDSW 11; rerata akurasi pencacahan 95,1% dan R2 0,96 terhadap hitungan manual.

bukti: the information obtained from the detection model is input into improved DeepSORT for continuous frame tracking of passion fruit
to overcome the problem of repetitive counting, a specific tracking counting method based on the track information and state is used for accurate passion fruit counting
The counting results from test videos are highly correlated with the manual counting results
catatan: Kutipan verbatim dari abstrak di halaman Springer. DeepSORT dikodekan M2+M3 sesuai konvensi. Abstrak tidak menyatakan apakah hitungan manual dilakukan pada video atau di kebun; ditafsirkan sebagai hitungan manual pada video uji (anotasi).

bukti: we proposed an improved YOLOX target detection algorithm to quickly and accurately detect sweet cherry ripeness categories in complex environments
we took a total of 2400 high-resolution images of immature, semi-ripe, and ripe sweet cherries in an orchard
Compared with the YOLOX model, the mAP of this method is improved by 4.12%, recall is improved by 4.6%, F-score is improved by 2.34%
catatan: Deteksi buah di pohon dengan atribut kelas kematangan dari citra tunggal, sehingga layak menurut protokol; C4 adalah kelompok terdekat. Abstrak hanya melaporkan metrik deteksi (mAP, recall, F-score) dan tidak menyebut pencacahan, sehingga penilai lain dapat membacanya sebagai X/E5.

bukti: The goal of this study was to develop a 3D point cloud-based approach for apple tree segmentation and architecture characterization
Tree height and trunk diameter were estimated based on the geometric information of the tree trunk
catatan: Objek ukur adalah batang dan cabang pohon apel dari awan titik LiDAR; buah tidak dideteksi maupun dicacah. Beban buah hanya disebut sebagai kegunaan lanjutan.

bukti: This study applies YOLOv8-pose variants of nano, small, and medium to detect ripe Fresh Fruit Bunches (FFB) and estimate their poses for orientation analysis in oil palm plantations
A custom dataset of ripe FFB images was annotated with five key point annotations representing anatomical features to support pose estimation
catatan: Tugas mencakup deteksi tandan matang dan estimasi pose; MUTU dipilih karena pose adalah kontribusi utama, DET juga cocok. Hanya satu kelas (matang), sehingga per_kelas N. Abstrak menyebut perkebunan tetapi tidak menyatakan apakah tandan masih di pohon atau di tanah; modalitas RGB disimpulkan dari pemakaian YOLOv8-pose.

bukti: a mobile device LiDAR sensor was used to collect 295 colorized point clouds of pepper, tomato, and watermelon plants
aboveground vegetative biomass, leaf and stem biomass, and leaf and stem number were physically measured in tomato and watermelon plants
catatan: Yang diukur adalah struktur vegetatif tanaman (tinggi, biomassa, jumlah daun dan batang); buah tidak dideteksi, dicacah, maupun diukur.
